role: Unmodified upstream leanVM CLI proving comparison

sampling.proving_statistic: Arithmetic mean of all five retained stock CLI per-pass times

boundaries.proving:
Whole stock aggregate::

invocation, including witness generation, after input/cache preparation
boundaries.recursion: Parent aggregation only; child proof construction excluded
boundaries.verification: Upstream quiet verifier; stock mean of five passes, no per-pass verification times exposed
boundaries.peak_rss: Lifetime peak of the parent CLI process; excludes child-process RSS and is not an isolated proving allocation measure
boundaries.not_measured: Network propagation, transaction/block building, finality or complete process latency
